name: Collin County Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Its 2026 slate card lists the Democrats on Collin County's November ballot and asks voters to take it to the polls (its own nominee list, not a separate endorsement vote).

name: Collin County Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Its 2026 Republican Candidates page lists the Republicans on Collin County's November ballot (its own nominee list, not a separate endorsement vote).

name: League of Women Voters of Collin County
lean_basis: Its own mission: "The League of Women Voters is a nonpartisan organization that does not support or oppose political parties or candidates." (lwvcollin.org)
